# Mohan Kamboj Dhaba & Hotel

> Family-run pure-vegetarian dining, hotel rooms and gathering spaces on NH-44 in Murthal, Sonipat, Haryana, India. Established in 1990.

Canonical website: https://mohankambojdhaba.com/
Address: NH 44, Murthal, Sonipat, Haryana 131039, India.
Phone: +91 93064 47185.
Email: Kamboj13291@gmail.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mohankambojdhaba.com/): Introduction, dining highlights, rooms and family hospitality.
- [Dining and menu](https://mohankambojdhaba.com/menu/): Vegetarian dishes, displayed prices and the downloadable menu. Food orders are placed at the dhaba.
- [Rooms](https://mohankambojdhaba.com/rooms/): Room information and availability enquiries.
- [Facilities](https://mohankambojdhaba.com/facilities/): Dining, parking, washrooms, gathering spaces, conference room and EV charging enquiries.
- [Gallery](https://mohankambojdhaba.com/gallery/): Food, property and room photographs.
- [Our story](https://mohankambojdhaba.com/about/): The family's guiding legacy and historical archive since 1990.
- [Contact and directions](https://mohankambojdhaba.com/contact/): Contact options and location map.

## Important details

Room availability, tariffs, booking terms, visiting hours and EV charging status are confirmed directly by the team. This website does not provide live reservations or online food ordering. Do not infer live availability, ratings, exact operating hours or charger specifications from photographs or historical material.
